description: Pivot from scattered platform (game + explore + validate) to one focused product: AI-powered idea validation. User pastes startup idea → We search YC database + live data sources → OpenAI generates validation report with score, insights, and recommendations. Two routes only: landing page (/) and report page (/report/[id]).

userStories.title: Simplify to single landing page
userStories.description: Replace current multi-tab navigation with a single focused landing page. One input field, one CTA. Remove all game, explore, leaderboard functionality from the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page at / shows heading 'VALIDATE YOUR STARTUP IDEA'
Subtitle: 'Against 5,500 YC companies + live market data'
Single large textarea for idea input
Example ideas shown below input for inspiration
Three feature badges: '5,500+ YC startups', 'Live news feed', 'Reddit sentiment'
Remove navbar tabs (Explore, Validate, Play, Submit)
userStories.notes: This is a dramatic simplification - one input, one output

userStories.title: Create validation API endpoint
userStories.description: Create POST /api/validate endpoint that orchestrates data fetching from multiple sources and AI analysis. Returns structured report data.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts POST with body: { idea: string }
Returns 400 if idea is missing or too short (<10 chars)
Fetches data in parallel: YC companies, news, Reddit, Google Trends
Passes aggregated data to OpenAI for analysis
Returns structured report: { id, score, sections: { historical, market, sentiment, trends, recommendations } }
Generates unique report ID for sharing
Saves report to database for retrieval
userStories.notes: Core orchestration endpoint - this is the brain

userStories.title: Implement YC company search
userStories.description: Create function to search YC database for companies with similar pitches. Returns matches with outcome data.
acceptanceCriteria: Tokenizes idea into keywords (lowercase, remove stop words)
Searches ideas table using ILIKE on hero and yc_name fields
Returns top 20 matches with: name, batch, pitch, outcome, team_size, slug
Calculates similarity score for each match

userStories.title: Implement news RSS fetching
userStories.description: Create function to fetch recent news about the idea topic from Google News and TechCrunch RSS feeds.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches from Google News RSS with search query
Fetches from TechCrunch RSS with search query
Parses RSS XML to extract: title, source, date, url
Handles fetch errors gracefully (returns empty array)
userStories.notes: RSS parsing can use a simple XML parser or regex

userStories.title: Implement Reddit search
userStories.description: Create function to search Reddit for discussions about the idea topic. Returns posts with sentiment indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Searches relevant subreddits: startups, SaaS, Entrepreneur, smallbusiness
Uses Reddit JSON API (no auth required): reddit.com/r/{sub}/search.json
Returns posts with: subreddit, title, score, comments, url
Returns top 15 posts across all subreddits
Handles rate limits and errors gracefully
userStories.notes: Reddit JSON API is public, no API key needed

userStories.title: Implement Google Trends data
userStories.description: Create function to get Google Trends data for the idea topic. For MVP, can use SerpAPI or mock data.
acceptanceCriteria: If using SerpAPI: fetch from serpapi.com/search.json with google_trends engine
If mocking for MVP: return reasonable placeholder data with note
Calculates percentage change over 2 years if data available
userStories.notes: SerpAPI requires API key - can mock for MVP and add later

userStories.title: Integrate OpenAI for analysis
userStories.description: Create function to send aggregated data to OpenAI and receive structured analysis. Uses GPT-4 for quality insights.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses OpenAI API with gpt-4o model
System prompt instructs to act as startup analyst
User prompt includes: idea, YC companies, news, Reddit posts, trends data
Requests structured JSON response with: score, historical, market, sentiment, trends, recommendations
Uses response_format: { type: 'json_object' } for reliable parsing
userStories.notes: OpenAI API key needed in env vars

userStories.title: Create reports database table
userStories.description: Create database table to store generated reports for sharing and retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: Columns: id (uuid), idea (text), score (int), report_data (jsonb), created_at (timestamp)
id is primary key with default uuid
Index on created_at for recent reports

userStories.title: Create report page route
userStories.description: Create /report/[id] page to display generated validation reports. Shareable URL for each report.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches report from database by ID
Displays full report with all sections
Includes Open Graph meta tags for social sharing

userStories.title: Create score display component
userStories.description: Create component to display the overall validation score prominently with visual gauge and label.
acceptanceCriteria: Color coded: green (80+), yellow (60-79), orange (40-59), red (0-39)
Label: Strong/Moderate/Risky/Caution based on score band
userStories.notes: This is the hero element of the report

userStories.title: Create historical analysis section
userStories.description: Create component to display historical analysis from YC data. Shows similar companies and their outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows count of similar companies found
Outcome distribution: unicorn/acquired/dead/active counts with emojis
Lists top similar companies with: outcome badge, name, batch, pitch

userStories.title: Create market analysis section
userStories.description: Create component to display current market analysis from news data.
acceptanceCriteria: Lists recent news articles: title, source, date
Articles are clickable links to original source
Empty state if no recent news found

userStories.title: Create sentiment analysis section
userStories.description: Create component to display community sentiment from Reddit data.
acceptanceCriteria: Lists top pain points/topics mentioned (from AI analysis)

userStories.title: Create trends analysis section
userStories.description: Create component to display Google Trends data with visual chart.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows trend line chart (can be simple CSS/SVG)
Graceful display if trends data unavailable

userStories.title: Create recommendations section
userStories.description: Create component to display AI-generated recommendations as actionable list.
acceptanceCriteria: Each recommendation has bold title and explanation
Based on data from all sections

userStories.title: Create report actions bar
userStories.description: Create component with share and new validation CTAs.
acceptanceCriteria: Share button copies report URL to clipboard
Share on Twitter/X button with pre-filled text
Validate Another Idea button links to home

userStories.title: Add loading state for validation
userStories.description: Create loading state shown while validation is processing. Shows progress indicators for each data source.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading component shows during API call
Shows checklist of data sources being fetched
userStories.notes: Good loading UX for slower AI calls

userStories.title: Add error handling

acceptanceCriteria: API errors return appropriate status codes
Client shows error message if validation fails
Partial failures handled (e.g., Reddit down but others work)

userStories.title: Add OpenGraph meta tags for reports

og:description includes score and key insight
og:image points to dynamic OG image or static fallback
Meta tags render correctly in social previews

userStories.title: Clean up unused code

Keep only: landing page, report page, validate API
No TypeScript errors from missing imports

userStories.title: Update branding and copy

userStories.title: Test validation flow end-to-end

userStories.title: Performance optimization
